sources.title: CDN cache hit ratio: the metric that actually matters
sources.snippet: There is no single ratio: the request hit ratio predicts origin CPU and the byte hit ratio predicts origin bandwidth, they diverge because small files dominate request counts while large files dominate bytes, and the per-request cache-status header is the ground truth.
